meta.title: LaTeX Studio
meta.description: Overleaf-style LaTeX workbench in the right sidebar: syntax-highlighted editing with line numbers and inline comments, one-click compile with clean/auto modes, live pdf.js preview, two-way SyncTeX jumps and multi-writer merge protection.

latexWorkbench.entry.aria: Open or close the LaTeX workbench
latexWorkbench.entry.label: LaTeX Studio
latexWorkbench.tab.title: LaTeX
latexWorkbench.guide.title: LaTeX Studio
latexWorkbench.toolbar.tex: main.tex — path relative to the workspace
latexWorkbench.warn.notincluded: the main document does not reference this subfile (its \input line may be commented out, so edits will not show in the PDF)
latexWorkbench.source.placeholder: Type or load a .tex path to edit its source.
latexWorkbench.pdf.empty: Compile the document to preview the PDF here.
latexWorkbench.log.title: Compiler output
latexWorkbench.error.subfile: Section subfile — no main document (a .tex containing \documentclass) was found automatically
latexWorkbench.sync.nodata: no SyncTeX yet — click Compile once to enable sync jumps
latexWorkbench.status.stale: the file changed on disk and could not be merged automatically — this save was aborted; click Save again within 30s to overwrite (the disk copy is backed up first)
latexWorkbench.status.conflict: external edits overlap yours on the same lines — save aborted so nothing is lost; click Save again within 30s to overwrite, or use ↻ to adopt the disk version (backups kept in .dsh-latex-studio-backups/)
latexWorkbench.status.diskchanged: the file changed on disk (another agent or device) — your next Save will merge both changes automatically
latexWorkbench.status.merged: saved — your edits and the external changes were merged automatically
latexWorkbench.status.adopted: file updated on disk — the latest version was loaded automatically
latexWorkbench.status.forced: overwrote the external version; the previous disk copy was saved under .dsh-latex-studio-backups/
